name: Knott's Churro Factory & Cable Car Kitchen Classic Cinnamon Churro (Skip Boysenberry Stuffing)
brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Churro Factory & Cable Car Kitchen (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Freshly fried tube of refined wheat choux dough rolled in cinnamon sugar—enjoyable when shared in remission as long as you order it un-stuffed.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Cinnamon-Sugar Churro (skip the Boysenberry-stuffed filling if it contains berry seeds) and share half.
